fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Ethiopia.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada a Etiopía.
entry.quote: valid for at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Ethiopia

entry.en: You can carry up to 3,000 Ethiopian birr when entering or leaving Ethiopia, and customs can seize more and you could get a prison sentence.
entry.es: Puedes llevar hasta 3.000 birr etíopes al entrar o salir de Etiopía; si llevas más, la aduana puede incautarlo y podrías recibir una pena de prisión.
entry.quote: You can carry up to 3,000 Ethiopian birr when entering or leaving Ethiopia.

entry.en: When you enter or leave Ethiopia, you must declare any cash over 10,000 US dollars or the equivalent in other currencies.
entry.es: Al entrar o salir de Etiopía debes declarar cualquier efectivo superior a 10.000 dólares estadounidenses o su equivalente en otras monedas.
entry.quote: you must declare any cash over 10,000 US dollars (or equivalent in other currencies)

entry.en: You must have a certificate of yellow fever vaccination if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Debes tener un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si llegas de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk

entry.en: It is illegal to import or export satellite phones, binoculars or drones to or from Ethiopia without prior approval.
entry.es: Es ilegal importar o exportar teléfonos satelitales, binoculares o drones hacia o desde Etiopía sin aprobación previa.
entry.quote: It’s illegal to import or export satellite phones, binoculars or drones to or from Ethiopia without prior approval

entry.en: Khat is legal in Ethiopia but it is illegal to take it out of the country.
entry.es: El khat es legal en Etiopía, pero es ilegal sacarlo del país.
entry.quote: Khat is legal in Ethiopia but it is illegal to take it out of the country.

safety.en: Mugging is on the rise in Ethiopia, and there have been a number of incidents of sexual harassment of women.
safety.es: Los atracos van en aumento en Etiopía y ha habido varios casos de acoso sexual a mujeres.
safety.quote: Mugging (violent theft or theft with the threat of violence) is on the rise. There have been a number of incidents of sexual harassment of women.

safety.en: Unrest can start with no notice, and there are ongoing armed clashes between ethnic groups and with security forces in much of the country.
safety.es: Los disturbios pueden empezar sin aviso y hay enfrentamientos armados continuos entre grupos étnicos y con las fuerzas de seguridad en gran parte del país.
safety.quote: Unrest can start with no notice. There are ongoing armed clashes between ethnic groups and with security forces in much of the country.

safety.en: Same-sex acts are illegal in Ethiopia and carry penalties of between 1 and 15 years in prison.
safety.es: Los actos entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales en Etiopía y conllevan penas de entre 1 y 15 años de cárcel.
safety.quote: Same-sex acts (applying to both sexes) are illegal and carry penalties of between 1 and 15 years in prison.

safety.en: Kidnapping is widespread in parts of Ethiopia, with incidents in the Oromia, Amhara and Somali regions and on the southern border with Kenya.
safety.es: El secuestro está extendido en partes de Etiopía, con casos en las regiones de Oromia, Amhara y Somali y en la frontera sur con Kenia.
safety.quote: Kidnapping is widespread in parts of Ethiopia, with incidents in the Oromia, Amhara and Somali regions and on the southern border with Kenya.

safety.en: There is a continued risk of landmines and other unexploded ordinances following the end of the 2020-2022 northern Ethiopia conflict.
safety.es: Sigue existiendo riesgo de minas terrestres y otros artefactos sin explotar tras el fin del conflicto del norte de Etiopía de 2020-2022.
safety.quote: There is a continued risk of landmines and other unexploded ordinances following the end of the 2020-2022 northern Ethiopia conflict.

safety.en: Avoid driving after dark anywhere outside Addis Ababa, because vehicles often have no lights and livestock may stray onto the roads.
safety.es: Evita conducir de noche fuera de Adís Abeba, porque los vehículos a menudo no llevan luces y el ganado puede invadir la carretera.
safety.quote: Avoid driving after dark anywhere outside Addis Ababa. Vehicles often have no lights and livestock may stray onto the roads.

health.en: Water-borne diseases are common, so drink or use only boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.
health.es: Las enfermedades transmitidas por el agua son comunes, así que bebe o usa solo agua hervida o embotellada y evita el hielo en las bebidas.
health.quote: Water-borne diseases are common. Drink or use only boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.

health.en: Malaria is common in areas of the country up to 2,000 metres above sea level.
health.es: La malaria es común en zonas del país de hasta 2.000 metros sobre el nivel del mar.
health.quote: Malaria is common in areas of the country up to 2,000 metres above sea level.

health.en: Bilharzia is present in the vast majority of lakes in Ethiopia, so check before swimming.
health.es: La bilharziasis está presente en la gran mayoría de los lagos de Etiopía, así que infórmate antes de nadar.
health.quote: Bilharzia is present in the vast majority of lakes in Ethiopia – check before swimming.

health.en: Only private hospitals in Addis Ababa offer a reasonable standard of basic care, and outside the capital medical facilities are extremely poor.
health.es: Solo los hospitales privados de Adís Abeba ofrecen un nivel razonable de atención básica, y fuera de la capital las instalaciones médicas son extremadamente deficientes.
health.quote: Only private hospitals in Addis Ababa offer a reasonable standard of basic care for minor health problems.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Ethiopia, including Addis Ababa.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en partes de Etiopía, incluida Adís Abeba.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Ethiopia, including Addis Ababa.

health.en: Wikivoyage advises not to drink the tap water, saying it is full of parasites.
health.es: Wikivoyage aconseja no beber agua del grifo, y dice que está llena de parásitos.
health.quote: Don't drink the tap water. It's full of parasites

help.en: The police and emergency number is 911, and the ambulance number in Addis Ababa is 907.
help.es: El número de policía y emergencias es el 911 y el de ambulancias en Adís Abeba es el 907.

help.en: FCDO says to dial 907 and ask for an ambulance.
help.es: El FCDO indica marcar el 907 y pedir una ambulancia.
help.quote: Dial 907 and ask for an ambulance.

help.en: The British Embassy in Addis Ababa may only be able to provide limited support in person because of the current political and security situation.
help.es: La Embajada Británica en Adís Abeba podría ofrecer solo apoyo presencial limitado debido a la situación política y de seguridad actual.
help.quote: The current political and security situation means the British Embassy in Addis Ababa may only be able to provide limited support in person.

getting_in.en: Bole International Airport in Addis Ababa is the main hub for Ethiopian Airlines.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional Bole de Adís Abeba es el principal centro de operaciones de Ethiopian Airlines.
getting_in.quote: Bole International Airport in Addis Ababa is the main hub for Ethiopian Airlines

getting_in.en: Other international airports are in Dire Dawa, Mekele and Bahir Dar.
getting_in.es: Otros aeropuertos internacionales están en Dire Dawa, Mekele y Bahir Dar.
getting_in.quote: Other international airports are in Dire Dawa, Mekele and Bahir Dar.

getting_in.en: From Kenya the border town is Moyale, and from Sudan the border village is Metema.
getting_in.es: Desde Kenia la ciudad fronteriza es Moyale, y desde Sudán la localidad fronteriza es Metema.
getting_in.quote: Border crossings from neighbouring countries include the border village of Metema to get in from Sudan.

getting_in.en: A train service between Addis Ababa and Djibouti City serves passenger trains taking roughly 12 hours for the whole trip.
getting_in.es: Un servicio de tren entre Adís Abeba y Yibuti ofrece trenes de pasajeros que tardan unas 12 horas en todo el trayecto.
getting_in.quote: A train service between Addis Ababa and Djibouti City serves passenger trains taking roughly 12 hours for the whole trip.

getting_in.en: Terminal 2 at Bole is the international terminal, while Terminal 1 serves domestic and some regional destinations.
getting_in.es: La Terminal 2 de Bole es la internacional, mientras que la Terminal 1 atiende destinos nacionales y algunos regionales.
getting_in.quote: Terminal 1 serves domestic and some regional (Djibouti, Nairobi, Khartoum, etc.) destinations.

getting_around.en: Ethiopian Airlines flights are often overbooked, so it is essential to reconfirm your tickets at least a day in advance.
getting_around.es: Los vuelos de Ethiopian Airlines suelen tener sobreventa, por lo que es esencial reconfirmar los billetes al menos un día antes.
getting_around.quote: Flights are often overbooked, so it is essential to reconfirm your tickets at least a day in advance

getting_around.en: Nearly all long-distance buses leave at dawn, and buses do not travel at night.
getting_around.es: Casi todos los autobuses de larga distancia salen al amanecer y los autobuses no viajan de noche.
getting_around.quote: nearly all long-distance buses leave at dawn (06:00 or twelve on the Ethiopian clock). Buses do not travel at night

getting_around.en: Ride hailing apps that work in Ethiopia include Little, Feres, Ride and ADIKA.
getting_around.es: Las aplicaciones de transporte que funcionan en Etiopía incluyen Little, Feres, Ride y ADIKA.
getting_around.quote: Here are some ride hailing apps that work in Ethiopia:

getting_around.en: Foreign driving licences are accepted, as Ethiopia is not a signatory to either International Driving Permit convention.
getting_around.es: Se aceptan los permisos de conducir extranjeros, ya que Etiopía no es signataria de ninguno de los convenios del permiso internacional de conducir.
getting_around.quote: nor is an international driver's permit (IDP) required, as Ethiopia is one of the few countries that is not a signatory to either IDP convention

getting_around.en: FCDO advises using only taxis organised by your hotel or travel company from the airport, and choosing yellow or app-based taxis rather than blue and white ones.
getting_around.es: El FCDO aconseja usar desde el aeropuerto solo taxis organizados por tu hotel o agencia, y elegir taxis amarillos o de aplicación en vez de los azules y blancos.
getting_around.quote: If you are booking your own taxi, choose yellow or app-based taxis rather than the blue and white ones.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage warns that minibuses and Higer buses are risky and contribute to Ethiopia's ranking among the most dangerous places to drive.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage advierte que los minibuses y autobuses Higer son arriesgados y contribuyen a que Etiopía figure entre los lugares más peligrosos para conducir.
getting_around.quote: It can be risky riding the minibuses and Higer, as they are a leading contributor to Ethiopia's position among the most dangerous places in the world to drive.

money.en: The local currency is the Ethiopian birr (ETB).
money.es: La moneda local es el birr etíope (ETB).
money.quote: Local currency is the Ethiopian birr, denoted by the symbol "Br" or "ብር " (ISO currency code: ETB).

money.en: Ethiopia is a cash-based society, and card payments and ATMs are limited and unreliable, especially outside cities.
money.es: Etiopía es una sociedad basada en el efectivo, y los pagos con tarjeta y los cajeros son limitados y poco fiables, sobre todo fuera de las ciudades.
money.quote: Ethiopia is a cash-based society. Banking facilities, including card payments and ATMs are limited, and unreliable, especially outside of cities.

money.en: Dashen Bank, Commercial Bank of Ethiopia and Awash Bank are the best bet for ATMs that take Visa, MasterCard and Chinese cards.
money.es: Dashen Bank, Commercial Bank of Ethiopia y Awash Bank son la mejor opción para cajeros que aceptan Visa, MasterCard y tarjetas chinas.
money.quote: Dashen Bank, Commercial Bank of Ethiopia and Awash Bank are your best bet for finding an ATM that takes Visa, MasterCard and Chinese credit/debit cards.

money.en: Keep your receipt if you change currency into birr, since without one you are unlikely to be able to change leftover money back.
money.es: Guarda el recibo si cambias moneda a birr, ya que sin él es poco probable que puedas cambiar el dinero sobrante al final.
money.quote: Keep your receipt if you change currency into birr. Without a receipt you are unlikely to be able to change leftover money back at the end of your trip.

money.en: Tipping is common in hotels, restaurants and bars, and car park attendants are also expected to be tipped.
money.es: La propina es común en hoteles, restaurantes y bares, y también se espera dar propina a los cuidadores de aparcamiento.
money.quote: In Ethiopia tipping is common in hotels, restaurants and bars. One is also expected to tip car park attendants

money.en: It is illegal to change money on the black market, although the rates are better than those offered by the banks.
money.es: Es ilegal cambiar dinero en el mercado negro, aunque las tasas son mejores que las de los bancos.
money.quote: It is illegal to change money on the black market but the rates are better than offered by the banks

etiquette.en: Avoid criticizing Ethiopian culture, especially the Ethiopian Orthodox brand of Christianity, and avoid contentious religious discussion.
etiquette.es: Evita criticar la cultura etíope, especialmente su tipo de cristianismo ortodoxo, y evita las discusiones religiosas polémicas.
etiquette.quote: Avoid criticizing their cultural lifestyle, especially their brand of Christianity (Ethiopian Orthodox).  Avoid all contentious religious discussion

etiquette.en: It is very important to remove your shoes when entering a home.
etiquette.es: Es muy importante quitarse los zapatos al entrar en una casa.
etiquette.quote: It is very important to remove your shoes when entering a home.

etiquette.en: It is a sign of respect for men to avoid eye contact with women.
etiquette.es: Es una señal de respeto que los hombres eviten el contacto visual con las mujeres.
etiquette.quote: It is a sign of respect for men to avoid eye contact with women.

etiquette.en: Women are expected to dress conservatively, especially when visiting religious sites.
etiquette.es: Se espera que las mujeres vistan de forma conservadora, sobre todo al visitar lugares religiosos.
etiquette.quote: Women are expected to dress conservatively, especially when visiting religious sites.

etiquette.en: It is illegal to take photos near military zones or of military personnel, near the Presidential Palace in Addis Ababa, or where signs prohibit photography.
etiquette.es: Es ilegal fotografiar cerca de zonas militares o a personal militar, cerca del Palacio Presidencial en Adís Abeba o donde haya carteles que lo prohíban.
etiquette.quote:
It is illegal to take photos:

- near military zones or of military personnel

- near the Presidential Palace in Addis Ababa

- anywhere that there are signs prohibiting photography

connectivity.en: Roaming with your home carrier is very expensive in Ethiopia, and getting a local SIM card is highly recommended.
connectivity.es: El roaming con tu operadora de origen es muy caro en Etiopía y se recomienda mucho obtener una SIM local.
connectivity.quote: roaming in Ethiopia with your home country's carrier is very expensive and is often not covered by discounted roaming packages

connectivity.en: Ethiopia has two mobile networks, Ethio Telecom (Ethiotel) and Safaricom.
connectivity.es: Etiopía tiene dos redes móviles, Ethio Telecom (Ethiotel) y Safaricom.
connectivity.quote: Ethiopia has two mobile phone networks - Ethio Telecom (Ethiotel) and Safaricom.

connectivity.en: Both carriers have shops in the arrivals area of Addis Ababa airport, and the seller must photograph you and take your passport information to activate the SIM.
connectivity.es: Ambas operadoras tienen tiendas en la zona de llegadas del aeropuerto de Adís Abeba, y el vendedor debe fotografiarte y tomar los datos de tu pasaporte para activar la SIM.
connectivity.quote: The system requires the seller to take a photo of you and your passport information to activate your SIM.

connectivity.en: Most Ethiopian internet providers block certain websites, throttle traffic and typically block regular VPN connections.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de los proveedores de internet etíopes bloquean ciertos sitios, limitan el tráfico y suelen bloquear las conexiones VPN normales.
connectivity.quote: Most Ethiopian Internet Service Providers, such as Ethiotel, block certain websites as well as throttle web traffic.

connectivity.en: Internet service is extremely limited outside major cities, though Addis Ababa and Dire Dawa are well served by high-speed internet.
connectivity.es: El servicio de internet es extremadamente limitado fuera de las grandes ciudades, aunque Adís Abeba y Dire Dawa cuentan con internet de alta velocidad.
connectivity.quote: That said, Addis Ababa and Dire Dawa are well-served by high-speed internet.
